decision.rationale: The official Department of Pediatrics homepage provides substantive public information about UBC pediatric academic leadership, clinical research and teaching at BC Children's Hospital. Its current homepage is a departmental news digest; the broader institutional purpose is academic pediatrics. Evidence describes province-wide and national work, not an exclusively Okanagan service.
evidence: https://pediatrics.med.ubc.ca/ | 3464f18402cff43d055547d37d52056e4d5aa060698355e80f8c11ed5c1de588 | Since joining BC Children’s Hospital and the University of British Columbia, he has built a highly successful research program, secured significant research funding, and produced influential scholarship with national and international impact.
https://pediatrics.med.ubc.ca/ | 3464f18402cff43d055547d37d52056e4d5aa060698355e80f8c11ed5c1de588 | Drs. Doan and Devlin were both awarded a 2025/26 Killam Teaching Prize from UBC.

rules.rationale: The homepage title explicitly identifies the department's current monthly announcements and academic news digest.

fallback.rationale: The host represents UBC's Department of Pediatrics and its academic community, clinical education, teaching and scholarship.
